# EdTech

Manage payments and financial operations of your educational institution from a consolidated dashboard. Create an online platform, track payments, and create payouts within minutes.

### Education and E-Learning

Educational institutions and e-learning platforms can leverage RazorpayX for hassle-free fee collection. Automated receipts, timely reminders, and an easy-to-use interface simplify the payment process for students and parents.

  
### Payout Links for Guest Instructors

     - Simplify payments using [Payout Links](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/payout-links.md), streamlining finance procedures.
     - Avoid bank details for one-time resources while maintaining proper records.
    

  
### Easy Accounting Integration

     - Easy reconciliation of multiple payouts.
     - Utilize [Accounting Integration](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/accounting.md) with [Zoho Books](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/accounting/zohobooks.md) and [Tally](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/accounting/tally.md), along with downloadable [Account Statements](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/account-statement.md).
     - Enhance visibility, transparency, and team collaboration while ensuring consented access.
    

  
### Manage Team and Custom User Roles

     - Assign roles and permissions to both vendors and freelancers, enhancing security and control.
     - [Custom User Roles](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/manage-teams/create-user-role.md) allow controlled access with or without [2FA](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/manage-teams/2fa.md).
     
    

  
### Bulk Payouts for Refunds and Scholarships

**Watch Out!**

RazorpayX Lite is currently not available for new merchants. To set up a new RazorpayX account, refer to [Current Account](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/account-types/current-account.md).

     - Use [RazorpayX Lite or Current Account](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/account-types.md) and [Bulk Payout Links](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/payout-links/bulk.md) for convenient student incentive payouts. 
     - Simplify rewards distribution using [Payout Links](https://razorpay.com/docs/build/llm-docs/x/payout-links.md) without the need for individual account details, improving efficiency.
